- **Faster moves to Frameleaf:** an imported library opens as soon as its photos and albums are in, instead of after every file has been read. Files are checked in the background, and a bar at the top of the screen shows what is still running, with Pause and Details. Thumbnails are made while the check runs; smart search and faces start when it finishes. Anything that doesn't match is kept and listed in Library care.
- **A finishing touch:** when everything has been set up, Frameleaf tells you your library is ready, with a small celebration.
- **Bringing your library over:** imports from LibrePhotos and PhotoPrism keep stacks, Live Photos, protected details and shared originals, and large LibrePhotos libraries import completely.
- **Downloads:** archives keep every original, including both halves of a Live Photo.
- **Albums:** a new album made from an album inside a collection now goes in the same collection.
- **Library:** the library updates straight away after you stack or unstack photos.
- **Frameleaf Manager:** can be managed over plain HTTP on your home network when you choose to, recovers from an update whose release was withdrawn, and sets up Unraid autostart on its own.
- **NAS packages:** TrueNAS packaging and the NAS catalogue listings are complete.
- **Studio and Cloud:** Studio tools start on desktop platforms, and Frameleaf Cloud work can ask for a bigger GPU when it needs one.
